prompts.mood_huff: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent desktop-pet animation sprite sheet. Generate ONE 1024x1024 PNG with EXACTLY FOUR full-body frames arranged in a 2x2 grid of equal square cells, read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Input image 1 is the EXACT shipped character and anatomy reference only: a horizontal idle animation strip, not the output layout. Preserve the adult chibi dragon-woman's SAME head diameter, full torso length, leg proportions, cardigan, dress and camera zoom in every frame. Silver-lilac fluffy short hair and ahoge, two pearl-lilac curved horns, pointed ears, purple eyes, green hairclip and ivory flower, lavender scarf, sage embroidered cardigan, cream dress, white socks and sneakers, TWO small lavender bat wings and ONE scaled lavender tail. Exactly two arms, two human hands, two legs. Fully include horns, hair, fingers, wings, tail and shoes inside every cell with clear transparent margins. Same delicate outlined painted anime style and pastel palette as the references. True alpha-zero transparent background: no floor, cast shadow, backdrop, checkerboard drawn into the image, text, symbols, labels, watermarks, motion marks or props. Cute small displeasure only, never violent anger, foot stamping, pointing, shouting or big happy grin. NO other person, disembodied hand, mouse cursor or touching hand may appear. Input image 2 is the matching character's existing pouting expressions and costume reference. All four frames are STANDING with both feet planted on one unchanged baseline and both arms gently folded across her cardigan. 1: small pursed mouth, eyebrows mildly drawn inward, gaze toward the viewer. 2: gently lift her chin a little and close her eyes for a small silent 'hmph', shoulders only barely rise. 3: shoulders settle and eyes reopen into a tiny displeased sideways glance, cheeks subtly puffed. 4: keep arms folded, chin returns slightly lower, still stubbornly pouting but cute. A subtle reaction within the same standing pose, not a walk or spin; no smile or instant forgiveness.
